title: Email Marketing Associate
description:
Join to apply for the Email Marketing Associate role at Darkroom .

About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. Founded in 2017 out of a conviction that iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different, Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across various e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability.

What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results‑driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and earned esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About the Role

We are hiring an Email Marketing Specialist – a sharp, creative thinker with a passion for storytelling, conversion, and customer retention. This is not a plug‑and‑play execution role; it requires a high level of ownership, creative problem‑solving, and a strong grasp of lifecycle marketing strategy. You’ll partner closely with Retention Managers and designers to develop and deploy high‑performing email and SMS campaigns for some of the fastest‑growing DTC brands in the world. From ideation and copywriting to QA and reporting, you'll be hands‑on throughout the lifecycle, translating insights into messages that drive revenue, deepen loyalty, and elevate the customer experience.

Darkroom is a career accelerator for marketers who want to operate at the intersection of creativity, commerce, and performance while mastering the tools and tactics of modern CRM strategy.

Fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and open to candidates based in Brazil, Portugal, Spain, Argentina, Colombia and Mexico.

A Day in the Life

  • Work directly with a Retention Marketing Manager to execute data‑driven email and SMS strategies for our DTC/e‑commerce clients.
  • On a daily basis, you will execute tasks for clients including writing, proofing, and scheduling email and SMS campaigns.
  • You’ll work directly with clients to manage the revision and approval process of their emails and SMS messages.
  • On a monthly basis, you’ll develop creative campaign concepts for your client's retention marketing calendars.
  • You’ll work directly with our in‑house design team to develop the design approach, ensuring the design vision for campaigns and flows comes to life, and managing the revision and approval process for client emails.
  • You’ll produce the copy for your campaign concepts and work directly with the client to gain approval on briefs before sending them to our in‑house designers.
  • Driven and enjoy coming to the team and clients with new retention marketing ideas.
  • Execute automation/flow logic set‑up, pop-up builds, and app integrations.

Who You Are

We're looking for an Email Marketing Specialist to join our team! In this role, you will write email and SMS marketing copy, build and deploy email and SMS flows and campaigns, and develop content for our e‑commerce, DTC clients.

  • You’re passionate about developing creative email and SMS marketing copy that drives loyalty and lifetime value for e‑commerce clients.
  • You have experience working in Klaviyo or a similar ESP.
  • You’re passionate about marketing, and especially interested in learning and growing in the DTC and e‑commerce marketing industry.
  • You’re a creative and experienced writer and looking to grow your career in marketing copywriting.
  • You're used to working in a fast‑paced environment and can project manage multiple tasks at once for yourself, your team and your clients.
  • You dedicate time to learning and being on the cutting edge of trends and best practices in the world of DTC marketing.

You Should Apply If This Sounds Like You

  • 2‑4 years of work experience in digital marketing, copywriting, growth marketing, e‑commerce, etc.
  • Past experience working at an agency or working with multiple clients in a fast‑paced environment.
  • Experience working with Klaviyo or similar email service providers.
  • Enthusiastic, passionate, and creative; thrives on thinking outside the box to create new best‑in‑class customer experiences.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, plus the ability to clearly articulate and express complex and sometimes technical ideas to a wide variety of people and groups at any level.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world‑class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. With hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, São Paulo, and Barcelona!
  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.
  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Field Compliance Coordinator - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package

Position : Field Compliance Coordinator with full relocation to Saudi Arabia as a permanent full‑time expatriate. Attractive relocation package. Qualified candidates will be contacted.

Position Description

We are seeking a Field Compliance Coordinator to join our Upstream OE & Compliance Division. The Division is responsible for providing safety support to Upstream Executive Management and various organizations through HSE reporting, safety audits, recommendations, human‑factor guidance, training, major incident investigations, and lessons‑learned creation. Your primary role will support upstream organizations on Process Safety and major incident investigations for onshore and offshore drilling and oil & gas processing plants.

Key Responsibilities

  • Enhance safety standards and procedures such as work permits, process safety, hazard identification, risk management, and emergency preparedness.
  • Develop loss‑prevention, fire‑prevention, and safety standards, procedures, and General Instructions (GIs) for matters not covered by existing resources.
  • Consult with upstream management to facilitate Safety Management System (SMS) enhancement.
  • Create critical safety documents for major activities such as job safety analyses and hazard identification plans.
  • Assist departments in preparing for major safety reviews, including loss‑prevention compliance reviews.
  • Research emerging safety technologies and conduct feasibility studies and cost analyses to identify improved solutions for existing safety problems and regulatory requirements.
  • Act as a process‑safety audit expert during design, construction, commissioning, turnover to operations, ongoing operations, change management, and decommissioning.
  • Develop and deliver safety training material and safe‑work procedures to field personnel.
  • Instruct on safety concepts, practices, and standards (both on‑the‑job and classroom).
  • Direct and participate in preparing major reference manuals documenting corporate and LP safety systems, policies, and procedures (e.g., LP Policy, SMS manual, Safety Handbook, Construction Safety Manual).
  • Facilitate and lead incident investigations, including interviewing witnesses, gathering data, and conducting root‑cause analysis.
  • Facilitate and lead safety audits by identifying non‑compliance with occupational health and safety regulations and advising on improvements.

Qualifications

description:

Buscamos um Analista N2 Pleno para cuidar da parte técnica da rede e apoiar a expansão da empresa.

Missão do cargo

Garantir que a rede funcione de forma estável , resolvendo problemas técnicos de clientes e da infraestrutura, atuando entre o atendimento N1 e a engenharia/N3 .

Atividades principais

  • Atender chamados escalados pelo N1 (casos que o N1 não conseguiu resolver).
  • Analisar conectividade :
    • Testes de ping e traceroute (IP e domínio).
    • Identificar se o problema está no cliente, na rede interna, no POP, na rota ou na operadora.
  • Acessar e analisar OLT GPON (ZTE, Huawei, Fiberhome, Nokia ou similar):
    • Ver potência RX/TX das ONUs.
    • Ver ONUs flutuando (online/offline).
    • Verificar erros e utilização das portas GPON.
  • Verificar e ajustar VLAN, PPPoE, IPoE e DHCP :
    • Sessões PPPoE travadas.
    • Cliente autenticando e não navegando.
    • Cliente sem IP ou recebendo IP incorreto.
  • Apoiar o time de campo com diagnóstico técnico (indicar provável ponto de falha).
  • Utilizar ferramentas de monitoramento (Zabbix, Grafana ou similares) para identificar e prevenir instabilidades.
  • Registrar nos chamados o passo a passo do diagnóstico e da solução .

Requisitos técnicos (obrigatórios)

  • Experiência prévia em provedor de internet ou suporte de redes .
  • Bom conhecimento de TCP/IP (IP, máscara, gateway, DNS, rota).
  • Entender bem PPPoE e/ou IPoE .
  • Saber trabalhar com VLAN (ACCESS/TRUNK, tagged/untagged).
  • Noções sólidas de IPv4 e NAT.
  • Uso prático de ping , tracert/traceroute e testes por IP e domínio.
  • Conhecimento básico em ao menos um equipamento de borda, por exemplo: Mikrotik, Cisco, Huawei ou similar .
  • Capacidade de leitura e interpretação de logs (roteador, OLT, servidor PPPoE/DHCP).

Diferenciais (não obrigatórios, mas contam ponto)

  • Experiência com OLT GPON (ZTE, Huawei, Fiberhome, Nokia, etc.).
  • Conhecimento de CGNAT / BNG / BRAS .
  • Experiência com Zabbix, Grafana ou outras ferramentas de monitoramento.
  • Noções de IPv6 .
  • Cursos ou certificações em redes (MTCNA, CCNA , etc.).
  • Já trabalhou em provedor de internet.
  • Sabe mexer em OLT GPON na prática (ver potência, ONU, porta, erros).
  • Usa Mikrotik ou similar no dia a dia.
  • Consegue resolver a maioria dos problemas sem supervisão.
  • Já trabalhou com redes/provedor.
  • Conhece TCP/IP, PPPoE, VLAN.
  • Atua com OLT GPON + Mikrotik + monitoramento (Zabbix/Grafana) .
  • Entende bem PPPoE, IPoE, VLAN, NAT, CGNAT/BNG .
  • Consegue segurar plantão e dar suporte ao time como referência técnica.

Perfil comportamental

  • Gosta de resolver problema até o fim , sem “empurrar para o outro”.
  • Sabe trabalhar sob pressão, mantendo calma e foco.Boa comunicação com N1, N3 e técnicos de campo .
  • Organização para registrar tudo o que faz.
  • Vontade de aprender e crescer junto com a empresa .

  • Sábado, das 09h às 13h

Estamos com uma posição para Engenheiro técnico de produto com foco em biquíni. Suas atividades estarão voltadas para o desenvolvimento, melhoria e controle de qualidade de produtos têxteis, atuando em diversas etapas do processo de criação e fabricação, garantindo que os produtos atendam aos requisitos técnicos e de mercado.

Atribuições e responsabilidades:

  1. Análise e Desenvolvimento de Produto
    • Desenvolver protótipos de novos produtos, considerando o design, materiais, funcionalidades e estética.
    • Elaborar fichas técnicas detalhadas com todas as especificações do produto (materiais, cores, tamanhos, acabamentos, técnicas de costura, etc.).
    • Avaliar e selecionar materiais adequados para cada tipo de produto, garantindo qualidade e adequação à funcionalidade do design.
  2. Processo de Produção
    • Definir os processos produtivos necessários para fabricar os produtos conforme os requisitos de qualidade e prazos estabelecidos.
    • Ajustar padrões de produção, como cortes, modelagem e costura, para garantir que o produto final atenda às especificações.
    • Monitorar o andamento da produção, identificar possíveis problemas técnicos e sugerir soluções para otimizar o processo.
  3. Controle de Qualidade
    • Realizar inspeções durante e após a produção para verificar se os produtos atendem aos padrões de qualidade estabelecidos.
    • Coordenar ou realizar testes de durabilidade, resistência, lavagem e outros parâmetros técnicos para assegurar a conformidade do produto final.
    • Identificar e tratar desvios de qualidade, propondo melhorias ou ajustes nos processos produtivos ou de design.
  4. Ajustes e Melhorias Contínuas
    • Coletar feedback de clientes, áreas de vendas e outras partes envolvidas para identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos produtos.
    • Propor melhorias no processo de produção visando reduzir custos, melhorar a eficiência e garantir a qualidade.
    • Acompanhar inovações tecnológicas no setor têxtil e sugerir a implementação de novas técnicas ou equipamentos que melhorem o produto ou o processo produtivo.
  5. Gestão de Documentação Técnica
    • Atualizar constantemente as fichas técnicas, garantindo que as informações estejam corretas e acessíveis para as equipes de produção e comercialização.
    • Elaborar relatórios técnicos sobre o andamento do desenvolvimento de produtos, incluindo testes, qualidade e melhorias implementadas.
  6. Interação com Outras Áreas
    • Colaborar estreitamente com equipes de design e estilistas para garantir que as ideias criativas sejam viáveis do ponto de vista técnico e de produção.
    • Fornecer suporte técnico para a equipe comercial, ajudando a explicar os diferenciais e especificações dos produtos aos clientes ou consumidores.
    • Treinar os operadores de produção, modelistas e outros profissionais envolvidos na fabricação sobre os processos e padrões exigidos.
  7. Sustentabilidade e Conformidade
    • Trabalhar para implementar práticas de produção mais sustentáveis, selecionando materiais ecológicos e otimizando processos para reduzir desperdícios.
    • Garantir que os produtos atendam às normas de segurança, regulamentos ambientais e padrões internacionais de qualidade.

Requisitos e qualificações:

Ensino superior completo em Engenharia têxtil;

Experiência em varejo de moda, com foco em biquíni.

Local de trabalho: São Cristóvão - RJ, 100% presencial.

title: Completion Engineer (Lower Completion Specialist)
description:
Focusing on lower completions, this position will plan, design, and execute lower completion and gravel pack operations, provide offshore technical supervision, coordinate with wells, subsurface, and operations teams, and ensure proper well closeout and reporting.

Responsibilities

  • Prepare and present well design concepts based on information provided by Subsurface team
  • Assist with the preparation of cost estimates used to generate yearly Budgets and well/project specific AFE's
  • Forecast and accountable for the timely ordering of well/project specific Long Lead requirements
  • Contribute towards logistical coordination & quality assurance of services, materials, equipment and personnel
  • Integrate with fellow drilling, completion/testing, subsea and/or subsurface team members as required
  • Perform special studies/duties if/as required including conducting service quality meetings
  • Ensure Vendor service deficiencies are correctly and timely captured via the Company non-conformance reporting (NCR) process so as to ensure timely action/close out
  • Support NCR and root cause failure analysis as required
  • Contributor to the development, management and updating of the Drilling Management System (DMS)
  • Ensure the DMS is followed during well planning, design, engineering, and execution and closeout activities
  • Ensure compliance with Company and Drilling & Completion policies, standards and approved procedures
  • Ensure compliance of Vendor supplied materials, equipment and services which includes review of design, pre-assembly verification, pre-installation testing and equipment documentation
  • Support the preparation of HSE documents if/where required
  • Contribute and participate in the hazard identification process
  • Contribute and participate in well/project specific risk assessments and pre-job planning meetings
  • Assist with the evaluation of rig and 3rd party services for hazards, well integrity and assurance
  • Support Drilling Management if requested in ER roles and incident investigations

Well/Project Specific Duties

  • Design Reservoir Lower Completion for producer and injector wells across different assets within the company
  • Perform Torque & Drag analysis for deploying lower completions in long horizontal wells. Specify landing string and evaluate the requirement for swiveling devices
  • Provide engineering support as part of the wells team which includes lower completion sizing and design, GP pumping schedule, costing and assisting with operation execution, as well as the services associated with these activities
  • Establish well/project life cycle functional and operational requirements, including material & equipment selection
  • Identify special Engineering Studies to be performed
  • Prepare well/project specific technical notes if/when required
  • Prepare detailed scopes of work for tender documents, perform vendor capability assessments, evaluate tenders methodically and capable of presenting a succinct recommendation
  • Raise Requisitions & Purchase Orders
  • Ensure compliance of Vendor supplied goods, materials, equipment and services which includes but is not limited to review of design, manufacturing processes, quality plans, post-manufacturing testing/verification, site receipt acceptance, pre-assembly verification, pre-installation testing and equipment documentation
  • Review all applicable operating, installing & testing procedures, including interface documents
  • Contribute and participate in DWOP/CWOP as part of well/project commencement
  • Assist with preparation of Management of Change (MOC) documents and conducting a risk assessment for those changes with relevant parties
  • Review field tickets and/or well invoices
  • Review the engineering focussed After Action Review (AAR) report and apply lessons learnt
  • Responsible for compilation of End of well Reports (EOWRs)

Requirements

Education

  • Degree qualification in Engineering
  • Well Control certification (IWCF) - Subsea/Surface Supervisor is considered an advantage

Experience

  • Experience in Lower Completion and GP Pumping engineering
  • Experience with lower completion and sand control designs and execution
  • Experience with Alternate Path GP pumping technology is considered an advantage
  • Knowledge of appropriate and relevant well engineering tools (e.g. Landmark Suite (or similar) - Wellplan, Stresscheck, Compass, etc), and software packages
  • Knowledge of GP pumping software PackPro or similar

Job Details

  • Seniority level: Mid-Senior level
  • Employment type: Full-time
  • Job function: Project Management
  • Industries: IT Services and IT Consulting

description:
Técnico de Imobilização Ortopédica - Rede Hospital Casa - CLT

Somos a Rede Hospital Casa, um dos maiores operadores médicos hospitalares independentes do estado do Rio de Janeiro. O ACOLHIMENTO COMO NOSSO JEITO DE CUIDAR está entre os nossos principais valores.

Estamos em busca de um profissional para atuar como Técnico de Imobilização Ortopédica que seja proativo, cuidadoso, dedicado e que tenha atenção e amor com seus processos de trabalho.

Suas principais atividades serão:

  • Assumir o posto de serviço conforme escala, devidamente identificado, uniformizado e com aparência pessoal adequada;
  • Identificar corretamente o paciente antes de realizar o procedimento;
  • Preparar paciente para procedimentos de imobilização ortopédica;
  • Preparar material para confeccionar as imobilizações;
  • Preparar sala para pequenos procedimentos fora do centro cirúrgico, como pequenas suturas e anestesia local para manobras de redução manual, punções e infiltrações;
  • Observar o tipo de imobilização a confeccionar, as condições do paciente, seguindo orientações e prescrição médica;
  • Confeccionar imobilizações e aparelhos gessados nas salas de gesso e cirurgia;
  • Confeccionar imobilizações com material sintético, aparelhos gessados, goteiras gessadas, esparadrapagem, talas digitais (imobilização para os dedos), enfaixamento, tração cutânea, colar cervical, entre outros, conforme prescrição médica;
  • Retirar aparelhos de imobilização ortopédica, conforme prescrição médica;
  • Utilizar de forma adequada equipamentos como serra elétrica vibratória;
  • Realizar procedimentos específicos em imobilizações ortopédicas, como a abertura de janelas no aparelho gessado;
  • Manter sala de imobilização organizada;
  • Zelar pela limpeza da sala, bem como organização e preservação e guarda de materiais e equipamentos de uso na sua especialidade;
  • Auxiliar o médico ortopedista em procedimentos ortopédicos não cirúrgicos, como na instalação de trações esqueléticas e manobras de redução manual;
  • Realizar lançamento e registro em prontuário dos procedimentos realizados e materiais utilizados;
  • Promover orientações pertinentes e de conservação da imobilização aos pacientes;
  • Auxiliar a equipe multidisciplinar em imobilizações de pacientes vítimas de trauma ou que necessitem de restrição total de movimento;
  • Obedecer às normas técnicas da Sociedade Brasileira de Ortopedia e Traumatologia (SBOT), às normas internacionais para confecção de imobilização, normas regulamentadoras de Segurança do Trabalho e o Código de Ética Profissional;
  • Notificar a equipe de enfermagem toda e qualquer ocorrência administrativa;
  • Notificar a equipe de enfermagem toda ocorrência durante atendimento ao paciente;
  • Participar de treinamentos institucional e setorial quando solicitado sua participação;
  • Cumprir as normas e regulamentos da Instituição, bem como as rotinas operacionais da sua Unidade;
  • Respeitar e conhecer os instrumentos normativos do setor como instruções de trabalho.

Esperamos que você tenha:

  • Ensino médio completo com curso técnico em imobilização ortopédica.
  • Registro no conselho de Classe.
  • Desejável experiência anterior de 06 meses.
  • Noções básicas de Primeiros Socorros a pacientes vítimas de trauma, Higiene ocupacional, biossegurança e ergonomia, equipamentos e Materiais ortopédicos.
  • Noções de Ortopedia e Traumatologia.

description:
Card Authority and Disputes Administrator

Join to apply for the Card Authority and Disputes Administrator role at Paymentology .

At Paymentology , we’re redefining what’s possible in the payments space. As the first truly global issuer‑processor, we give banks and fintechs the technology and talent to launch and manage Mastercard and Visa cards at scale across more than 60 countries. Our advanced, multi‑cloud platform delivers real‑time data, unmatched scalability, and the flexibility of shared or dedicated processing instances. It's this global reach and innovation that sets us apart.

We’re looking for a Card Authority and Disputes Administrator to manage and process chargebacks, transaction disputes, and card authority operations across global card networks. This role ensures every case and authorisation exception is validated, documented, and resolved in line with regulatory and card scheme standards. You’ll play a key role in protecting clients and cardholders from financial loss while upholding Paymentology’s operational integrity, operating independently on assigned cases and prioritising workload against SLA and regulatory deadlines.

Responsibilities

  • Handle and process cardholder disputes involving authorised and unauthorised transactions.
  • Conduct detailed investigations using multiple internal systems and external partners.
  • Validate data accuracy and ensure all documentation meets compliance and network standards.
  • Determine appropriate actions and craft timely, accurate responses to networks within SLA and regulatory timelines.
  • Oversee card authority processes including transaction approvals, declines, and authorisation reviews.
  • Provide guidance to internal teams and clients on dispute outcomes, escalations, and card authorisation queries.
  • Maintain current knowledge of card scheme rules, dispute categories, and operational procedures.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives in dispute resolution, authorisation processes, and reporting accuracy.

Requirements

  • Strong understanding of Visa/Mastercard dispute and card authorisation processes and compliance standards.
  • Skilled in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Outlook, Word) and case management tools.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Analytical, customer‑centric, and detail‑oriented, with the ability to work to tight deadlines.
  • Able to coordinate with card network partners, client operations teams, and internal reconciliation staff to ensure compliance and customer satisfaction.
  • 2–4 years in dispute resolution, card operations, or financial customer service.

What You Can Look Forward To

At Paymentology , it’s not just about building great payment technology, it’s about building a company where people feel they belong and their work matters. You’ll be part of a diverse, global team that’s genuinely committed to making a positive impact through what we do. Whether you’re working across time zones or getting involved in initiatives that support local communities, you’ll find real purpose in your work and the freedom to grow in a supportive, forward‑thinking environment.

title: Case Manager
description:
At Gilead, we’re creating a healthier world for all people. For more than 35 years, we’ve tackled diseases such as HIV, viral hepatitis, COVID-19 and cancer – working relentlessly to develop therapies that help improve lives and to ensure access to these therapies across the globe. We continue to fight against the world’s biggest health challenges, and our mission requires collaboration, determination and a relentless drive to make a difference.

Every member of Gilead’s team plays a critical role in the discovery and development of life-changing scientific innovations. Our employees are our greatest asset as we work to achieve our bold ambitions, and we’re looking for the next wave of passionate and ambitious people ready to make a direct impact.

We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfil their aspirations. Join Gilead and help create possible, together.

Job Description

Specific Job Responsibilities:

  1. Responsible for monitoring Kite Konnect program.
  2. Collaborates with other key Gilead team members to establish and manage contracted relationships with select specialty distributors and specialty pharmacies.
  3. Works closely with Regulatory, Legal, Com Ops and other partners/stakeholders to ensure fully compliant practices, policies & procedures both internally and with vendor.
  4. Provides input on partner selection based on core capabilities, market presence, and likely Gilead business value.
  5. Contributes to criteria and reporting required for new programs in order to support new product launches while continually reviewing existing programs and evaluating additional development needed.
  6. Investigates and responds to internal and external customer complaints while concurrently instituting necessary improvements to avoid recurrence.
  7. Produces accurate, timely and insightful management reports regarding program trends.
  8. Provides substantive analysis that accurately incorporates the partnership agreements and the projected financial impact.
  9. Considers the need to audit external vendors to ensure compliance of agreement and policies.

Specific Education & Experience Requirements:

10+ years of related experience in biotech or pharmaceuticals industry and a BS or BA degree, including leadership experience in executing trade management activities.

Knowledge:

  • English fluency is mandatory
  • Ability to multi-task across a wide variety of tactical and strategic activities.
  • Able to effectively manage others in accomplishing necessary tasks, both direct reports and others in related areas of Gilead.
  • Able to influence and provide recommendations to senior management.
  • Ability to recognize and interpret business issues/opportunities and recommend solutions through analysis, then implement and/or negotiate solutions with external parties.
  • Excellent analytical skills with an emphasis on follow-through, and issue resolution abilities.
  • Microsoft Excel/Word & PowerPoint and strong working knowledge of order management and information management systems.

title: Engenheiro de Projetos de Perfuração - Rio de Janeiro/RJ
description:
Engenheiro de Projetos de Perfuração - Rio de Janeiro/RJ

Join to apply for the Engenheiro de Projetos de Perfuração - Rio de Janeiro/RJ role at Infotec Brasil

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Concepção de projeto de perfuração;
  • Análise e cadastro de insumos;
  • Análise e elaboração de resumo de ocorrências dos poços de correlação;
  • Elaboração ou avaliação de estudo de geopressões, geomecânica e estimativa de fechamento;
  • Assentar sapatas atendendo às normas de segurança e ao escopo do projeto;
  • Classificar a criticidade de poço;
  • Disponibilização dos insumos para projetos especializados e estimativa de duração e custos;
  • Preenchimento dos dados básicos no sistema de projetos e no de orçamentação;
  • Solicitação e análise crítica de estudos de geologia e caracterização biológica do leito marinho;
  • Solicitação e análise crítica de diagrama de restrições para operações em poços offshore;
  • Solicitação e análise crítica de documento declaratório de formações com potencial de fluxo;
  • Solicitação de estrutura analítica de projetos (EAP);
  • Solicitação de estudos especializados de perfuração de poços (projetos de revestimento, cabeça de poço, fluidos, BHA, direcional, perfilagem, alargamento e testemunhagem);
  • Solicitação e análise crítica de riser analysis e WSOG;
  • Solicitação de estimativa de duração probabilística da intervenção;
  • Condução de reunião de pré-projeto, de GEP (Grupo de Empreendimento de Poço) de planejamento, GEP de execução e de planejamento integrado de poço;
  • Participação nas reuniões operacionais, de gestão de mudança de seus poços, de CCAPE e CCAPD dos poços por ele projetados e dos eventos de lições aprendidas;
  • Elaboração dos documentos resultantes do projeto de perfuração (dados básicos, resumo executivo de FEL, cronograma executivo de perfuração e book de projetos);
  • Elaboração de documentos para órgãos externos (parceria, ANP e demais órgãos);
  • Preencher o checklist de perfuração em sistema;
  • Suporte ao coordenador de GEP durante toda a execução e passagem de serviço do poço;
  • Participação nas reuniões do poço projetado (como análises de risco e gestão de mudança);
  • Elaboração de análise preliminar de riscos, conforme padrões e normas;
  • Avaliação de sondas quanto otimização a segurança operacional contemplando, mas não limitado aos seguintes itens (Capacidade de corte do BOP, disponibilidade de EDS’s, avaliação do sistema de compensação e de posicionamento dinâmico da unidade e dos obstáculos na locação);
  • Elaboração de gestões de mudança de projeto;
  • Suportar a elaboração do documento de passagem de serviço dos poços (Handover);
  • Suportar a elaboração das análises de envelope operacional e conjunto solidários de barreiras.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Formação: Curso de Nível Superior em Engenharia em instituição reconhecida pelo Ministério da Educação (MEC) ou outro órgão do governo federal destinado a esse fim, com registro no respectivo Conselho de Classe.
  • Experiência: Em projeto e/ou execução de perfuração de poços de petróleo offshore.
  • Conhecimentos Técnicos: Competência de Dados — tratamento, transferência, coleta, organização, agrupamento, noções de análise estatística, árvore de decisão; Pacote Office: Word, Excel, Power Point; Power BI: Noções, filtros, organização dos dados, pesquisa. Operação básica com dados; Noções de projeto de poço marítimo; Noções de construção de poço direcional, vertical e horizontal como operador e como projetista: premissas básicas de projetos, limitações e boas práticas em projetos e execução; Noções de equipamentos de sondas de perfuração; Noções de conceitos básicos de perfuração direcional; Conhecimento de ferramentas direcionais: motores de fundo, rotary steerable e turbinas de perfuração (seleção, limites operacionais, vantagens e desvantagens e operação); Noções de ferramentas de mapeamento de poço: MWD, GWD, Gyro; Noções de ferramentas de perfilagem: LWD e ferramentas a cabo. Limites e operação (poço aberto e poço revestido); Influência do direcional nas descidas a cabo por gravidade; Noções de projeto de BHA: tubulares, alargadores, escareadores, percussores de perfuração; Noções de operação e projeto utilizando sistemas de alargamento (alargadores, ferramentas de eliminação de offset broca x alargador em manobra única, estabilização no poço alargado etc.); Noções de simulação: torque e drag, hidráulica de poço e desgaste de revestimento; Noções de brocas de perfuração: seleção e cálculo de hidráulica; Noções de hidráulica de poço: correlação entre limpeza de poço e geometria de trajetória; Noções de segurança de poço e análise anticolisão entre poços; Noções de geologia e geodésia; Noções de orçamentação de poços; Noções de operação e projeto de testemunhagem; Noções de operações e projeto de canhoneio; Noções de operações e projeto de MPD; Noções básicas dos tipos de completação (contenção de areia, completações simples e inteligentes, etc.); Noções básicas sobre cimentação, recimentação e correção da cimentação; Aplicação do canhoneio nos diferentes tipos de completação (cargas e densidades); Noções básicas de workover e de abandono; Noções básicas de caracterização de reservatório (geologia, geofísica e avaliação de reservatórios); Idiomas: Português (Brasil) - escrita e oral – nível fluente; Inglês técnico - escrita e oral - nível intermediário; Possuir noções básicas de construção de poços marítimos e dos equipamentos e sistemas de unidades de perfuração marítima; Desejáveis noções básicas em brocas, perfuração direcional, MPD, integridade de poços, estabilidade geomecânica de poços, fundações de poços, fluidos de perfuração, cimentação e equipamentos que compõem a estrutura de poços (cabeça de poço, revestimentos etc).

Etapas do Processo Seletivo

  • Inscrição
  • Testes
  • Entrevista com RH
  • Validação de Requisitos
  • Entrevista Técnica
  • Contratação

Somos a Infotec Brasil, uma empresa referência nacional em terceirização de serviços, processos (BPO) e pessoas. Em 2025, celebramos 40 anos de trajetória, atuando com excelência nos setores de Óleo e Gás, Energia, Mineração e Siderurgia.

Na Infotec, o colaborador é protagonista da própria jornada. Oferecemos um ecossistema completo de apoio, desenvolvimento e reconhecimento, com destaque para:

  • Central de Atendimento ao Colaborador (CAC); suporte humanizado desde o onboarding até o dia a dia;

  • My Redcognition: nossa plataforma de gamificação que reconhece e valoriza conquistas individuais e coletivas, além de ser um canal ativo de comunicação interna;
  • Ambiente colaborativo, ágil e orientado a resultados;
  • Oportunidades reais de crescimento com base em meritocracia;

  • Projetos com grandes empresas do cenário nacional e foco em excelência operacional.

Capco is looking for a skilled Data Scientist to join our hybrid team in Rio de Janeiro.

Requisitos Mandatórios

  • Experiência com análise e modelagem de dados aplicada à indústria de óleo e gás, atuando em empresas do setor energético ou projetos de engenharia de dados e analytics.
  • Vivência em projetos de otimização operacional, manutenção preditiva e monitoramento de ativos.

  • Habilidade com Power BI, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud (foco em infraestrutura Petrobras), Hadoop, Kafka.
  • Familiaridade com DevOps e MLOps: Docker, Kubernetes, Git, CI/CD.

  • Graduação em Engenharia, Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática, Física ou áreas correlatas.
  • Certificação válida (ex.: PMI-ACP, PMP, Lean Six Sigma Black Belt, SAFe); se não houver, não há necessidade adicional.

Requisitos Desejáveis

  • Certificação Microsoft Power Platform, Azure Solutions Architect, Automation Anywhere.
  • Experiência em Inteligência Artificial e Machine Learning para análise avançada de dados.
  • Habilidades de soft skill, comunicação e capacidade de trabalhar em ambientes dinâmicos.

Atribuições

  • Atuar nos subeixos de conformidade, desenvolvimento de habilidades e competências, negócios, processos, projetos, cadeia de suprimentos e transformação digital.
  • Coordenação técnica, análises críticas, apoio estratégico, otimizações e estudos técnicos.
  • Condução de trabalhos técnicos especializados, desenvolvimento de soluções e melhoria de processos.

Implementations Project Manager, Fund Admin

The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world‑class software, purpose‑built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end‑to‑end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

At Carta we create owners and make private markets liquid.

We live in a world where some people live on the equity stack and enjoy exponential wealth growth and preferential tax treatment; others live on the debt stack and may work their entire lives for a company and retire only with the cash they’ve managed to save from their paychecks. Our contribution to solving the wealth inequality problem is moving people from the debt stack (payroll) to the equity stack. By making it as easy to issue equity to employees as it is to put them on payroll, we can create more owners.

At Carta, we are helpful, transparent, fair, and kind. We are relentless executors, unconventional thinkers, and masters of our craft.

To learn more, here is what one of our investors wrote about leading our Series F.

The Problems You’ll Solve

As an Implementations Project Manager, you will focus efforts on supporting new Investor Services customers in their journey into Carta services. You will drive operational excellence within our fast‑growing Investor Services business by coordinating, facilitating and managing on‑boarding activities that are critical to achieving success for both our customers and Carta within a tight deadline.

  • Support new Fund Administration, Portfolio Insights, and Valuations' clients by on‑boarding them onto Carta – i.e., implementation of client’s limited partners list, investments, capitalization table and securities
  • Extract relevant information from operating agreements and subscription documents to upload limited partners to Carta
  • Analyze data thoroughly and precisely to maintain data integrity throughout the on‑boarding process
  • Effectively liaise between sales and Investor Services teams as the bridge post‑sales through implementation
  • Coordinate and manage multiple/simultaneous implementation projects by continually communicating with and motivating clients
  • Continuously look for ways to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the on‑boarding process
  • Work closely with product and engineering to improve the on‑boarding experience for customers

The Impact You’ll Have

You’ll play a critical role in the transformation of the financial services industry through partnering with our new clients and helping them implement our software. In this role you will be responsible for interacting with a fund’s back office (CFO, fund manager) to collect their historical data, provide advisory support, and ultimately deliver accurate data to both the client and internal stakeholders.

About You

From sale close, to implementation, and continued customer success, the ideal Implementations Project Manager will exhibit excellent communication skills, a high degree of problem‑solving, velocity, embracing change and will constantly seek ways to better their process to provide customers with a world‑class on‑boarding experience.

description:
This opportunity is only for candidates currently residing in the specified country. Your location may affect eligibility and rates. Please submit your resume in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

At Mindrift, innovation meets opportunity. We believe in using the power of collective human intelligence to ethically shape the future of AI.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform, launched and powered by Toloka, connects domain experts with cutting‑edge AI projects from innovative tech clients. Our mission is to unlock the potential of GenAI by tapping into real-world expertise from across the globe.

Who we’re looking for

We’re looking for curious and intellectually proactive contributors, the kind of person who double‑checks assumptions and plays devil’s advocate. Are you comfortable with ambiguity and complexity? Does an async, remote, flexible opportunity sound exciting? Would you like to learn how modern AI systems are tested and evaluated?

Type of role

This is a flexible, project-based opportunity well‑suited for:

  • Analysts, researchers, or consultants with strong critical‑thinking skills
  • Students (senior undergrads / grad students) looking for an intellectually interesting gig
  • People open to a part‑time and non‑permanent opportunity

About the project

We’re on the hunt for QAs for autonomous AI agents for a new project focused on validating and improving complex task structures, policy logic, and agent evaluation frameworks. Throughout the project, you’ll have to balance quality assurance, research, and logical problem‑solving. This project opportunity is ideal for people who enjoy looking at systems holistically and thinking through scenarios, implications, and edge cases. You do not need a coding background, but you must be curious, intellectually rigorous, and capable of evaluating the soundness and consistency of complex setups.

What you’ll be doing

  • Reviewing evaluation tasks and scenarios for logic, completeness, and realism
  • Identifying inconsistencies, missing assumptions, or unclear decision points
  • Helping define clear expected behaviours (gold standards) for AI agents
  • Annotating cause‑effect relationships, reasoning paths, and plausible alternatives
  • Thinking through complex systems and policies as a human would to ensure agents are tested properly
  • Working closely with QA, writers, or developers to suggest refinements or edge case coverage

How to get started

Apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to a project aligned with your skills, on your own schedule. Shape the future of AI while building tools that benefit everyone.

Requirements

  • Excellent analytical thinking: can reason about complex systems, scenarios, and logical implications
  • Strong attention to detail: can spot contradictions, ambiguities, and vague requirements
  • Familiarity with structured data formats: can read, not necessarily write JSON/YAML
  • Ability to assess scenarios holistically: what’s missing, what’s unrealistic, what might break?
  • Good communication and clear writing (in English) to document your findings.

We also value applicants who have

  • Experience with policy evaluation, logic puzzles, case studies, or structured scenario design
  • Background in consulting, academia, olympiads (e.g. logic/math/informatics), or research
  • Exposure to LLMs, prompt engineering, or AI‑generated content
  • Familiarity with QA or test‑case thinking (edge cases, failure modes, “what could go wrong”)
  • Some understanding of how scoring or evaluation works in agent testing (precision, coverage, etc.)

Benefits

  • Get paid for your expertise, with rates that can go up to $17/hour depending on your skills, experience, and project needs
  • Take part in a flexible, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments
  • Participate in an advanced AI project and gain valuable experience to enhance your portfolio
  • Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise

Seniority level

Employment type

  • Part‑time

title: Static Mechanical Engineer - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package
description:
Static Mechanical Engineer - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package

Full relocation to Saudi Arabia – permanent full-time Expat Relocation Package.

Job Overview: We are seeking a Plant Corrosion Engineer to join the Riyas Engineering Division (RNGLFD) which is part of the Riyas NGL Fractionation Dept (RNGLFD).

RNGLFD is responsible for two trains, each designed to process 255 MBOD (242.25 MBCD). Each train will include fractionation units, C3 & C4 treatment, C3 & C4 dehydration and propane refrigeration. The common facilities will include feed and product surge storage, chemicals storage and utilities including, but not limited to, steam and condensate recovery systems, utility water, plant, instrument air and nitrogen systems, machinery cooling water, drainage and flare systems. Some of the systems (e.g., steam headers, flare headers, product storage) have been pre-invested for the future train.

Your primary role will be to implement, support and continually improve RNGLFP inspection corrosion management programs and provide consolatory advice in materials, ensuring cost effective material selection and corrosion mitigation strategies, which will ensure mechanical integrity of the materials, applied on all plant assets including equipment and piping through their life cycle.

Key Responsibilities

  • Implement corrosion management program and on-stream monitoring and Conduct risk-based inspection based on API-580 methodology.
  • Review and approve recommended solutions for coating failures and cathodic protection and participate in HAZOP review sessions and ensure that all issues are addressed.
  • Manage water treatment program and recommend solutions to overcome challenges and review design packages and validate materials selection based on current code and standards.
  • Validate corrosion controls corrosion controls, corrosion (CCD), corrosion loops and corrosion damage mechanisms frequently.
  • Assess FEED composition changes and approve recommended solution to assure assets integrity.
  • Develop scope and description of technology items, and lead field implementation.
  • Develop and transfer knowledge about use of coating, Cathodic protection (CP), corrosion inhibitors and other corrosion controls and best practices.
  • Extract data and draw conclusions from Corrosion Monitoring Technologies, and troubleshoot corrosion problems and address root causes.
  • Perform the regular review and update on the plants Integrity Operating Windows (IOW) and Corrosion loops drawings shall be updated by adding emerging damage mechanisms or removing damage mechanisms because of plant upgrades.
  • Adjust and modify inspection practices and programs shall be reflected based on such modifications and perform special studies in corrosion control. Evaluates data as to scope, impact and long-range cost effectiveness on existing and new projects.
  • Review operations and monitoring activities to identify needed system modifications or procedural changes associated with corrosion control with conduct corrosion mitigation and integrity review to optimize the inspection and corrosion programs and maintain assets integrity.

Qualification Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, preferably in mechanical engineer.
  • 15 years' experience processing in Oil/Gas Industry.
  • Demonstrate experience in material science and metrology, different NDT technology and their applications and knowledge in engineering aspect of welding.
  • Strong Knowledge of international standards and codes NACE, ASME, API and ASTM especially inspection and corrosion standards such as API-571, API-580, API-570 and API-510.
  • Valid NACE Specialist Certification or NACE Senior Corrosion Technologist or combination of NACE Corrosion Technologist, API-571 and NACE CP level II.

description:
PROJETISTA ELETROMECÂNICO DE LINHAS DE TRANSMISSÃO - RIO DE JANEIRO

SOBRE A NIP DO BRASIL
Somos uma empresa de engenharia consultiva especializada em soluções para infraestrutura, energia e meio ambiente. Atuamos com inovação, precisão técnica e responsabilidade socioambiental. Nossa missão é transformar desafios em soluções sustentáveis, gerando impacto positivo para o Brasil e suas comunidades.

Valorizamos um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo, inclusivo e focado no desenvolvimento humano. Na NIP, cada pessoa tem espaço para crescer e contribuir com propósito.

Missão da Posição

Atuar no desenvolvimento de projetos eletromecânicos de linhas de transmissão até 138kV, com foco em qualidade técnica, atendimento aos requisitos normativos e prazos contratuais. Contribuir de forma estratégica para o desempenho dos projetos da NIP, liderando entregas técnicas, interações com clientes e acompanhando a equipe de engenharia.

Responsabilidades Principais

  • Levantar dados preliminares de campo e referências técnicas (topografia, georreferenciamento, interferências, servidões, condicionantes ambientais).
  • Definir traçado da linha, escolher o melhor percurso considerando restrições técnicas, ambientais e custos, com otimização de rota.
  • Dimensionar eletromecânica e elétrica da linha (condutores, para-raios, isoladores, espaçamentos, esforços de tração e flecha), incorporando critérios de amortecimento, vibração e fadiga.
  • Projetar estruturas de sustentação (torres, postes), definindo tipologia, perfis, empenos, cargas de vento, gelo (quando aplicável) e requisitos de fabricação.
  • Projetar fundações para torres / postes com base nos levantamentos geotécnicos e cargas atuantes.
  • Elaborar memoriais descritivos e memoriais de cálculo que detalhem hipóteses adotadas, normas aplicadas, critérios de dimensionamento e justificativas técnicas.
